name: issue-487-pdf-mode
description: PDF mode (docs/specs/pdf-mode.md), with no pref set: fixture:pdf-links.pdf (4 pages, an outline, 3 links) opens in Firefox's PDF viewer, in the theme, with the outline shown beside it, and takes zathura's keys at once; 3G goes to page 3, and Tab moves into the outline panel on the left, in INDEX mode, with the entry for page 3 selected (pdf-outline). Esc closes it, back in normal mode. The status bar shows the fixture server's port, a few digits that vary between runs, well inside the 0.5 % screenshot tolerance.
